title: Cemu 2.0-91: official experimental build
summary: Cemu published 2.0-91 on July 27, 2024. The release record documents an official experimental build for the Wii U emulator project.
searchKeywords: Wii U emulator release update changelog

blocks.text: The Cemu project published version 2.0-91 on July 27, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official release description states: Cemu experimental release
